notes.title: Calculus Cube and Talking ChatGPT
notes.notes:
The Calculus Cube is ready to teach six foundational concepts in calculus: functions, continuity, limits, derivatives, infinitesimals and infinity, and Integrals.  In game chatGPT now comes with voice recognition and STT.  Choose from male or female voices and give chatGPT a back story (personal chatGPT key required).

Let us know if you would like to see any particular features.  Up next arithmetic and algebra archery range, achievements.  I am also hoping to add a first quest drawing together features from around the island so you can start to build your ship.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Calculus Cube Update In Progress
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111162/b6533a0e6cfe7e838bd7e1473a51dc4fb90e12f0.jpg[/img]
I am currently working on the Calculus Cube update, a series of kiosks giving an intuitive introduction to key concepts in differential and integral calculus.  Also in this update, we are rolling out a 'talk to the librarian' feature where users can interact using speech with chatGPT through the librarian UI (your own chatGPT key is required).  We are making good progress and expect to release this update sometime in January.

notes.title: Fixes Hand Orientation When Using Stamps
notes.notes: Standardizes marker grab-hand thumbstick for stamp selection when using stamps panel.

notes.title: Introducing the Stamps Package!
notes.notes:
Players can now create custom math equations using the stamps panel on their marker and add them to any available board.  Grab your marker, press the b-button, and click the "stamps" button to reveal the stamps panel.  The thumbstick allows navigation to individual stamp images which can be added to the stamp by the trigger.  Click on other buttons to create stamp templates like summation, product, radical, and more...
Click the stamps button again to return to normal locomotion.  Stamps can be shared live to other peoples board.  Enjoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111162/0328017d965e0d1f4cff582c86b5affd030da9ab.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Talk Math With A Developer
notes.notes:
Stop in to the Orca Virtual room on Learning The Maths every Wednesday from 11AM to noon CST to chat math with Larry, our lead developer on Learning The Maths.  Get input and insights into new features and have fun sharing about math. Starts 9/11/24

C-you then!

notes.title: Learning The Maths (Early Access) released!
notes.notes: We are happy to release our new app "Learning The Maths" to early access.  It is already a full-featured chat app with private and public rooms, and some interesting math content.  Looking forward to community feedback as we take this further.
